text:
Ellen: Borealis wants a one-week Private/VPC POC next Thu. Requirements: SAML assertions must never egress to the public internet, prefer IPv6 for app traffic, and they need a concise non-technical note PrivateLink vs Peering for procurement. Can NetOps + Sec give quick guidance?

Ravi: Short summary for procurement: PrivateLink -> endpoint-level isolation and a very small allowlist (improves auditability). Peering -> L3 routing with broader access surface and more route-table work. If SAML must not leave their network, either (A) Private deployment or (B) PrivateLink + SAML bridge inside their VPC.

Jordan: IPv6 note: our hosted PrivateLink connector is IPv4-only today. For demo, we can support IPv6 client traffic if the customer configures NAT64/DNS64 or an IPv6->IPv4 gateway for connector subnets. Native v6 on the connector is an engineering roadmap item. Flag as a blocker if native v6 is non-negotiable.

Ellen: They also want a minimal firewall snippet and a pre-provision checklist so NetOps can stand this up tomorrow if we greenlight.

Ravi: Example firewall snippet (placeholder CIDRs):
TCP 443 -> 34.199.200.0/22   # control-plane callbacks / auth
TCP 443 -> 52.205.64.0/22    # model-serving endpoints (hosted)
# Optional: ICMP for health checks to 34.199.200.0/22
# If static egress required: allow TCP 443 from our published EIP list (we will share exact IPs)

Jordan: TLS inspection caveat: if their perimeter performs TLS MITM, they must either allow SNI passthrough for our hostnames or install our cert chain into the inspection device. Otherwise SAML POSTbacks and cert pinning checks may fail.

Ellen: Draft POC preflight checklist to hand them:
1) Provide VPC (recommended /20) or designate an existing VPC with two spare private subnets.
2) Reserve two private subnets for connector components (no public IPs).
3) Pre-authorize outbound HTTPS to our control-plane CIDRs (we'll send exact ranges before the call).
4) If they want IPv6 app traffic: deploy NAT64/DNS64 or an IPv6->IPv4 translation gateway for connector subnets and validate with our test endpoints.
5) If SAML must remain private-only: deploy a lightweight SAML bridge VM in their VPC that proxies assertions to our control plane over PrivateLink.
6) Optional: request static egress EIPs for IdP callbacks; we will provide the list.

sec-bot: Borealis marked "no shared IPs." PrivateLink offers endpoint-level isolation but not guaranteed single-tenant hardware. If they require dedicated physical hosts, open a dedicated-hosting request with Ops. :lock:

Ellen: Thanks. Can we do a short 30-min call at 4pm PT today to finalize the memo and the firewall list? I'll send the one-pager to procurement right after.

Ravi: 4pm works. Jordan?

Jordan: In. I'll bring CIDRs and a short NAT64 runbook.

Ellen: Great  I'll schedule and share the finalized checklist after the call. :thumbsup:
